Provisional metro transfer to LIS. Airport operator describes about 20 minutes from Saldanha and about 10 minutes from Oriente; the arriving international bus terminal is not fixed, so neither station is asserted as the actual start. Planning allowance: 60 minutes, excluding airline check-in/security time. EUR 2.40 = published EUR 1.90 Carris/Metro ticket plus EUR 0.50 occasional card, assuming one metro journey and a new card. Confirm bus terminal, walking access, airport terminal and operating hours for the travel date. Geometry and distance remain unresolved; no route or booking verification.

Airport and coach operator confirm buses between Dublin city and DUB, serving both airport terminals. Planning allowance: 90 minutes for local access, waiting and road traffic; not a published timetable duration and excludes airline check-in/security. The incoming ferry arrival and chosen city stop still need a linked port-to-stop connection. Do not equate the operator fastest city journey with a port-to-airport journey. Ticket price, departure, terminal, exact stops and booking requirement remain unknown. Existing geometry is only an endpoint connector.
